title: How to "Dry-Brine" Pork Chops
description: Chef John's overnight "dry-brine" technique will produce the juiciest and most flavorful pork chops you've ever had.

steps.text: Mix kosher salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper together in a small bowl to make the dry brine. Generously apply mixture to both sides of pork chops. Transfer chops to a rack on a paper towel-lined baking sheet. Refrigerate uncovered 18 to 24 hours.
Preheat grill to medium or medium-high heat. Brush pork chops on each side with a few drops of vegetable oil.
Grill chops until internal temperature reaches 135 degrees F (60 degrees C), turning to evenly brown on each side. Transfer to platter and allow to rest 5 minutes.

video.description: Salt, ground pepper & cayenne = perfect dry rub/brine for center cut pork chops. Generously apply the rub to the pork chops and transfer the pork chops to a rack for a day of “brining.” Once the day of brining has passed, you’re ready to prepare your chops any way you most like, though grilling is recommended. Let ‘em rest for about 5 minutes, then plate and enjoy!
